note.summary: This chunk (Welsh-language HS320 helpsheet) explains Top Slicing Relief (TSR) eligibility and calculation order relative to Qualifying Policy relief and time-apportionment reduction, then covers losses on policies (no relief available), deficiency relief conditions and effect, and claims for wholly disproportionate gains on part surrenders/assignments. It then details the different calculation methods for gains on maturity/full surrender, death, sale/assignment, part surrenders/assignments, and PPB (personal portfolio bond) gains, using the formula Total Benefits (TB) minus (Total Deductions (TD) plus Previous Gains (PG)), with worked numerical examples.
